name: Amazon 'work from home' task job
why: Asks for a 'refundable registration fee' to a UPI ID (direct fraud indicator in the message) AND uses a gmail recruiter plus an Amazon-lookalike domain (independent sender-identity evidence).

case.message:
Dear Candidate,

Greetings from Amazon India HR Team!

Your profile has been shortlisted from Naukri for the post of Data Entry Executive (Part Time / Work From Home). No interview required - direct joining.

Salary: earn Rs 3,000 to Rs 8,000 per day by completing simple online tasks.

To activate your employee ID, pay the one-time refundable registration fee of Rs. 499 to our UPI ID amazonhr.jobs@ybl within 24 hours. Seats are limited. Don't worry, the fee is refunded with your first salary.

For queries contact HR Neha Sharma on WhatsApp only: +91 98765 43210 (no calls please).
Email: amazon.hr.recruitment@gmail.com
Website: https://amazon-hr-careers.online

Regards,
Talent Acquisition Team, Amazon India
